gmailSetup.zh-CN: 在 Google Cloud 创建项目，启用 Gmail API，配置 OAuth 同意屏幕（测试模式时添加自己的 Gmail 为测试用户），创建「桌面应用」OAuth 客户端，下载 JSON 并在这里导入。随后点击连接 Gmail，完成只读授权。
gmailSetup.en: Create a Google Cloud project, enable Gmail API, and configure the OAuth consent screen. In testing mode, add your Gmail address as a test user. Create a Desktop app OAuth client, download its JSON, and import it here. Then connect Gmail and grant read-only access.

gmailPrivacy.zh-CN: 仅读取邮件，不发送或删除邮件。凭据由 Windows 账号加密；同步后的邮件正文保存在本机，完整备份也会包含它们。Google 测试模式授权可能到期，需要重新连接。
gmailPrivacy.en: Emails are read only, never sent or deleted. Credentials are encrypted with your Windows account. Synced emails are stored locally and included in full backups. Google testing-mode authorization may expire and require reconnection.

backupDescription.zh-CN: ZIP 包包含投递记录、JD、更新历史、每份 CV 和动机信，以及已同步邮件。Gmail 登录凭据不包含在内。请把备份复制到其他磁盘保存。
backupDescription.en: The ZIP includes applications, job descriptions, history, every CV and cover letter, and synced emails. Gmail credentials are excluded. Keep a copy on another drive.
